scope: Diagnostic run with additional RAF wrappers; no matched performance A/B. Each frame linked by sampleBefore/sampleAfter and rafIndex, never by equal indices. Timing is Page wall time; no native-entry absolute timestamp. Registered wait requires visible lifecycle, known game parent/callback, intact hooks, active state and explicit unpaused boundaries.

diagnosticMetadata.clock: Page performance.now(); rafTimestamp is the browser supplied frame timestamp, not entry time.
